name: communication-kit
description: Draft everyday messages and documents, or rewrite supplied material while preserving facts, positions, conditions and commitments.

interface.shortDescription: Draft clear messages and faithful document revisions
interface.longDescription: Explicitly request a message, document or faithful rewrite. Resolve critical gaps before drafting, review language and evidence, and receive a usable draft with brief key notes. Save or edit Markdown/TXT files only when requested.
defaultPrompt: Use $communication-kit:communicate to draft or faithfully rewrite this message or document. Ask and wait if a critical detail is missing, then deliver the draft and brief key notes.
